## The problem

What is hard or impossible today, and for whom.

## What you would expect instead

## How we would know it works

The observable result a test could assert. A change starts from its scenarios, so this section matters more than the rest.

## Anything else

Prior art, a sketch, a link. Please do not open a pull request before the behavior is agreed on; see `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
